notes.title: Regarding the MOD Database feature in certain languages
notes.content:
In the latest 1.3.0 patch for Card-en-Ciel, we included a new feature called the MOD Database that includes information on the game worlds and characters within Card-en-Ciel. However, many players have noticed that when the game language is set to French, Italian, German, Spanish, or Brazilian Portuguese, the MOD Database will appear in English. Unfortunately, it was not feasible for us to translate this text into these languages.

In the interest of transparency, the bulk of this text was originally written for the Card-en-Ciel website as promotional material. The website itself is only available in Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, and Korean, and was translated gradually (from Japanese) as it was added to the site over time. After we decided to include this background text in the actual game, we investigated having it translated into the remaining languages.

However, the MOD Database ended up being considerably large. The amount of text in it exceeds even the entire text of the original Card-en-Ciel release by a considerable amount. After considering the time and cost involved in translating the text, we unfortunately determined that it was not feasibly to translate the text in the 5 aforementioned languages. As a result, the text in-game appears in English when set to those languages.

We deeply apologize for this inconvenience and for the oversight in not mentioning this prior to the release of the MOD Database. We humbly ask for your understanding in this matter.

Sincerely,
INTI CREATES

notes.title: Card-en-Ciel Official Soundtrack and discounted bundle now available!
notes.content:
A big thanks to everyone enjoying Card-en-Ciel.

We have received many requests from fans for the game's soundtrack on Steam.

That soundtrack, previously only available in the console collector's edition in Japan and Asia, is now available on the Steam Store.

Naturally, it includes all 17 background tracks, but also all 50 vocal songs performed by Card-en-Ciel's Muses with intros and outros, different from the looping versions in the game. 67 tracks are included in total.

Images of the CD album's original artwork, liner notes, and lyrics are included as well.

We have also released a discounted "complete the set" bundle together with the game, so new and previous owners can receive the same discount.

We hope that anyone interested will consider buying it!

■Card-en-Ciel Official Soundtrack
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3306340/

■Card-en-Ciel and Soundtrack Bundle
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46642/

notes.title: 11/1 Follow-up report : Regarding the pre-order bonus
notes.content:
To all customers who pre-purchased Card-en-Ciel,

We thank your for patience regarding the distribution of the pre-purchase bonus game, Divine Dynamo Flamefrit.

After initial investigations, we were able to ensure that Flamefrit was added to the libraries of pre-purchase customers. However, it has remained locked and unable to be played.

Upon further inquiries with Valve, we determined that it would not be possible to unlock this game before its general release. We offer our sincere apologies for this situation.

In order to provide the best possible solution in this situation, we have decided to launch the game on Steam as soon as we are able, ahead of its release on consoles.

Divine Dynamo Flamefrit will release on Steam on November 14th, at which point anyone who pre-purchased Card-en-Ciel will be able to play it.

We thank you for your understanding and hope that you enjoy Flamefrit and Card-en-Ciel!

notes.content:
To customers who purchased the pre-order bundle of Card-en-Ciel + Divine Dynamo Flamefrit:

As of now, we have worked with Valve to resolve the issue of Divine Dynamo Flamefrit not appearing the the libraries of customers who pre-purchased.

Currently, the game is set to unlock when Divine Dynamo Flamefrit releases on Steam.

We will keep you updated on the situation as it progresses.

notes.title: Card-en-Ciel demo available now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3155230/CardenCiel_Demo/

Card-en-Ciel’s extensive free demo is available now on Steam! Experience the deck-building, story, battles, and meta progression of the early dungeons just as they appear in the full release!

Freely roam around dungeons and battle the enemies you choose. You can take as much or as little time as you need to recruit new cards to your deck before you take on the boss at the end! Clear the dungeons to earn Decode Tokens that unlock permanent upgrades and new difficulty levels to challenge.

The demo features nearly 100 of the over 300 cards from the final game, and 2 full replayable dungeons to unlock after you finish the tutorial. Each dungeon is its own roguelite experience where you’ll find different cards to build your deck on the way to the boss. But they don’t just disappear when you’re done, you’ll add them to your collection to summon into battle on later runs as Wild Cards!

Your demo save will transfer to the full game when it releases October 24th, including your permanent upgrades and the cards you’ve collected!

Download the demo today!
